translations.label.title: Title
translations.message.script_example_outputs: A node gets the values of its declared inputs and returns values for its declared outputs.
translations.message.script_example_branches: Only the outputs you return are passed on, so the nodes connected to an output you leave out do not run.
translations.message.script_example_upstream: Connect an output of another node to an input of this one: its result arrives in inputs under this node's input name. By default the node runs once every connected node has delivered its value.
translations.message.script_example_environment: A node declares each Variable it needs and reads its value from env.variables. Stop at once when a required one is missing: retrying can't set it.
translations.message.script_example_images: Image, video and file values are URLs. Pass the URL to the service that needs the file, and return the URLs of the files it made.
translations.message.script_example_libraries: Import a library by its URL, for example from esm.sh, jsr.io, deno.land or cdn.jsdelivr.net. Imports from hosts that Piper does not allow are blocked.
translations.message.script_example_repeat: Return repeat to run the node again later: start a job on the first run, keep its id in state and check it on the next runs. The progress you return is shown on the node. Give up with TIMEOUT_ERROR when the job takes too long.
translations.message.script_example_children: A node can launch a deployed pipeline and wait for it. The node runs again after each delay, and children holds the state of every child under the key you chose. A failed child fails this node. A node starts at most 10 children, children nest at most 3 levels deep, and the Deploy needs pipeline outputs and its own concurrency scope.
translations.message.script_example_errors: Console messages appear in the node's logs. A thrown error is retried; an error with the code FATAL_ERROR or TIMEOUT_ERROR fails the node at once.
translations.message.confirm_generate_api_key: Previously generated key will be invalid
translations.message.no_runs_in_period: No finished runs in this period.
